name: Woofer
summary: A mute button for a pumping speaker: sound rings get sucked back in, the cone gulps and the beads settle
about: A studio monitor with a big drawn woofer that pumps to a 100 bpm beat while sound rings roll across the cabinet and loose beads hop on the cone. Muting folds the icon's waves in and draws a cross, sucks the rings back into the speaker, makes the cone gulp and stop and lets the beads drop and settle under a red light. Unmuting lands one big thump with a shock ring and leaping beads, and the volume slider really drives the cone, rings, beads and level bars.
how: Press Mute (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space) to silence the speaker; the song keeps playing.
Press Unmute to bring the sound back with a thump.
Drag the volume slider, or use the arrow keys on it, to change how hard the cone pumps.
Slide the volume to 0 to mute; moving it up again unmutes.
